narrative: Material PL1__ME1021F3 exhibits an erratic demand pattern (CV=0.77) with a mean of 634 units/day and high intermittency (21% zero-demand days). Lead times are stable (mean=2.22 wd, σ=1.08 wd), and demand variability drives 66% of the combined lead-time-demand variance. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy is recommended with safety stock 990 units (vs SAP's 685), a reorder point of 2742 units, and order quantity 12087 units; storage capacity constrains the EOQ from 14752 to 12087, yielding estimated annual total cost of €5,940.
warnings: Capacity constraint binds: unconstrained OQ=14752 capped to 12087 (storage=13077, SS=990).

research_insights.selection_rationale: The (r,Q) continuous-review policy is appropriate because demand is erratic but not intermittent enough for Croston-class models (non-zero fraction=79%). Continuous review suits materials where stockouts are costly and lead times are variable. EOQ-based sizing balances ordering and holding costs given the low unit cost (€1.5161), moderate ordering cost (€50), and 12% holding rate.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap of 13077 units reduced order quantity from 14752 to 12087. This limits replenishment cycle length and increases ordering frequency, raising ordering costs slightly but remaining within feasible bounds.
